title: Pippi Longstocking
author: Astrid Lindgren
short_summary: Pippi Longstocking is a fiercely independent nine-year-old who lives alone at Villa Villekulla — no parents, just her pet monkey Mr. Nilsson and her horse, which she can lift over her head. Impossibly strong and entirely unbothered by grown-up rules, Pippi fills her days with wild games alongside her neighbors and best friends, Tommy and Annika.
extended_summary:
Pippi Longstocking is a fiercely independent nine-year-old who lives alone at Villa Villekulla — no parents, just her pet monkey Mr. Nilsson and her horse, which she can lift over her head. Impossibly strong and entirely unbothered by grown-up rules, Pippi fills her days with wild games alongside her neighbors and best friends, Tommy and Annika.

Pippi's father is a sea captain who she believes has become king of a faraway island, and she has a suitcase full of gold coins to live on. She refuses to go to school, outsmarts burglars and policemen who try to interfere with her life, and turns everyday chores into games — all while showing surprising kindness underneath her wild, rule-breaking exterior.
